name: Viridescent-Monolith
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against binary sunset (multiple suns), and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
